item.title: ai: Azure Content Understanding GPT-5 Series Guide: Model Selection, Grounding Improvements, and Confidence Enhancements
item.description:
Azure Content Understanding is adding support for the GPT-5 series and updating grounding and confidence features. The change is intended to improve model selection flexibility, efficiency, and extraction quality across document, image, audio, and video content.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: github: Enterprises can default to auto model selection
item.description:
Enterprise admins can now set model: auto in enterprise-managed managed-settings.json so GitHub Copilot uses auto model selection by default for new conversations. This setting is added in .github-private/.github/copilot/managed-settings.json for enterprise-managed configuration.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: devops+ai: 🔥Designing Specialized Agents - Model Selection, Tool Scoping, and Output Contracts🔥
item.description:
The article frames specialized agents as being given a limited toolbox and clear instructions. It points to three design areas: choosing the model, scoping the tools it can use, and defining output contracts.

  • Source: Let’s do DevOps

item.title: github: Evaluation models in auto for individual plans
item.description:
GitHub Copilot now includes evaluation models for individual non-enterprise users, and these models may be selected by Copilot auto model selection. Users can disable evaluation-model usage in Copilot.

  • Source: GitHub
